curation.decisionReason: The benchmark includes a released test split with defined evaluation metrics and is intended for broader use, including multilingual translations.

evaluationEvidence.reuse: The test split, PetQA-Bench, is released with annotations, and translated versions in five languages are provided to facilitate broader use.
evaluationEvidence.scoring: Metrics include ROUGE, BERTScore, and LLM-as-a-judge for factuality and helpfulness under three settings: zero-shot inference, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and supervised fine-tuning (SFT).
evaluationEvidence.task: PetQA is a Korean long-form question-answering benchmark containing 10,076 text-only and 8,751 multimodal QA pairs derived from real-world questions about dogs and cats, paired with answers from expert veterinarians.
